title: Backpropagate through a convolution
brief: Write col2im as a scatter-add, use it to count how many windows cover each pixel, and build the full backward pass of a convolution. Gradients are checked against finite differences.
hints: col2im mirrors im2col: reshape dcol to (N, C, k, k, H_out, W_out), then for each kernel offset (dh, dw) add dcol_r[:, :, dh, dw] into the same strided slice of a zero padded canvas. Use += because windows overlap.
After the loop, cut the padding off. When padding is 0, return the canvas as it is: canvas[:, :, 0:-0] is empty.
window_coverage is col2im applied to an array of ones with the shape im2col would produce for a single one-channel image.

conv2d_backward: db = dY_mat.sum(axis=(0, 2)); dw_mat = einsum('nol,ncl->oc', dY_mat, col); dcol = einsum('oc,nol->ncl', w_mat, dY_mat); then dx = col2im(dcol, ...). Reshape dw_mat back to the shape of w.
